tools.name: search_cards
tools.description: Find Tangy Limes video greeting cards. Each card is a short music video where real faces from a photo sing an original song. Filter by words (e.g. "dog birthday", "roast", "Paris anniversary"), occasion, and how many faces the card fits.

tools.name: get_card
tools.description: Details for one card by id: title, occasion, headline, how many faces, formats, length, price and links.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Tangy Limes prices: one card, the 3-pack, the custom song, and the first-card email offer. No subscription.

tools.name: make_card_link
tools.description: A link that opens a card on tangylimes.com, ready for the person to add their photo and watch the free preview. Add a discount code to apply it automatically.

tools.name: buy_cards
tools.description: Make a Stripe checkout link for packs of 3 cards ($4.99 a pack). The person pays on Stripe; the cards are then added to the account for the email given, and they make each card on tangylimes.com by signing in with that email. Nothing is charged until they pay. Always show the link to the person; nev

tools.name: request_card
tools.description: Ask the studio to make a card that doesn't exist yet. Leave an email to hear when it's ready.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "buy_cards" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Make a Stripe checkout link for packs of 3 cards ($4.99 a pack). The person pays on Stripe; the cards are then added to the account for the email given, and the…

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "buy_cards" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_pricing · Public sink: get_pricing, buy_cards, request_card.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_pricing · Public sink: get_pricing, buy_cards, request_card

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
